def factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime(df):
    """Volatility asymmetry of intraday returns amplified by volume regime (CogAlpha module)."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["open"] - 1.0
    up_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(lower=0), 2)
    down_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(upper=0), 2)
    asym = up_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() - down_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    # Amplify by continuous volume ratio, preserving asymmetry direction
    df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime"] = asym * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime"]
description: Preserves the core volatility asymmetry mechanism from the elite parent (difference between exponentially weighted upside and downside squared intraday returns) while replacing the ad-hoc volume acceleration (rolling 5/20-day mean ratio) with the built-in CogAlpha volume regime module. The module provides a standardized volume ratio (current volume / EMA20 of volume), which measures short-term volume intensity in a more robust and globally consistent manner. This refinement aims to improve stability and reduce overfitting risk while keeping the economic intuition of directional conviction amplified by volume.
